---
title: "ellmer maintenance"
author: "updated `{r} format(Sys.time(), '%a %b %d %X %Y %Z')`"
format:
  dashboard:
    theme: flatly
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(readr)
library(dplyr, warn.conflicts = FALSE)
library(DT)

issues <- read_csv("data/ellmer_issues.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
prs <- read_csv("data/ellmer_prs.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c"))

read_if_exists <- function(path) {
  if (file.exists(path)) {
    read_csv(path, col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
  } else {
    NULL
  }
}
reported <- read_if_exists("reported.csv")
parity <- read_if_exists("chatlas_parity.csv")

# Manually-maintained triage statuses, keyed by issue/PR number.
# Lives outside data/ so the daily CI fetch never overwrites it.
triage <- read_if_exists("triage.csv")
if (is.null(triage)) {
  triage <- tibble(number = character(), status = character())
}
add_triage <- function(df) {
  df |>
    left_join(
      triage |> select(number, triage_status = status),
      by = "number"
    ) |>
    mutate(triage_status = coalesce(triage_status, ""))
}

link_title <- function(url, title) {
  paste0('<a target="_blank" href="', url, '">', title, "</a>")
}

pr_links <- function(linked_prs) {
  vapply(strsplit(ifelse(is.na(linked_prs), "", linked_prs), "; "), function(nums) {
    nums <- nums[nums != ""]
    if (length(nums) == 0) return("")
    paste(
      link_title(
        paste0("https://github.com/tidyverse/ellmer/pull/", nums),
        paste0("PR #", nums)
      ),
      collapse = ", "
    )
  }, character(1))
}

not_ignored <- function(df) {
  filter(df, is.na(ignore) | toupper(ignore) != "TRUE")
}

suggestions <- bind_rows(
  if (!is.null(reported)) {
    reported |>
      not_ignored() |>
      transmute(
        type = "provider",
        source = provider,
        title = link_title(link, title),
        description = description,
        date = change_date
      )
  },
  if (!is.null(parity)) {
    parity |>
      not_ignored() |>
      transmute(
        type = "chatlas",
        source = "chatlas",
        title = link_title(link, title),
        description = description,
        date = merged_date
      )
  }
) |>
  arrange(date == "unknown", desc(date))
```

## Row

### Column {.tabset width="55%"}

#### Issues

```{r}
#| title: !expr paste0("Open issues (", nrow(issues), ")")
issues |>
  add_triage() |>
  arrange(desc(updated_at)) |>
  transmute(
    issue = link_title(url, paste0("#", number, " ", title)),
    labels = labels,
    comments = comments,
    updated = substr(updated_at, 1, 10),
    status = triage_status,
    linked = pr_links(linked_prs)
  ) |>
  datatable(
    escape = FALSE,
    rownames = FALSE,
    options = list(pageLength = 15, dom = "ftip")
  )
```

#### PRs

```{r}
#| title: !expr paste0("Open PRs (", nrow(prs), ")")
prs |>
  add_triage() |>
  arrange(desc(updated_at)) |>
  transmute(
    pr = link_title(url, paste0("#", number, " ", title)),
    author = user,
    draft = draft,
    updated = substr(updated_at, 1, 10),
    status = triage_status
  ) |>
  datatable(
    escape = FALSE,
    rownames = FALSE,
    options = list(pageLength = 15, dom = "ftip")
  )
```

### Column {.tabset width="45%"}

#### Provider updates

```{r}
#| title: Provider updates
suggestions |>
  filter(type == "provider") |>
  select(-type) |>
  datatable(
    escape = FALSE,
    rownames = FALSE,
    options = list(pageLength = 10, dom = "ftip")
  )
```

#### chatlas

```{r}
#| title: chatlas parity
suggestions |>
  filter(type == "chatlas") |>
  select(-type, -source) |>
  datatable(
    escape = FALSE,
    rownames = FALSE,
    options = list(pageLength = 10, dom = "ftip")
  )
```
